summary: This Phase 3 study tests the drug inclisiran compared to a placebo in adults hospitalized for acute coronary syndromes, which are serious heart conditions. The trial aims to see how the treatments affect LDL-C, also known as "bad" cholesterol, when started early in the hospital alongside standard care. Novartis Pharmaceuticals is sponsoring the study, with a target of 300 participants. The status is currently Recruiting.
